Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the scare! In most cases, this data isn't actually lost — here's what's likely happening and how to check.

When tasks are moved to a board that doesn't have a matching 'Priority Score' custom field configured, Loopwise hides the values on the task cards rather than deleting them. The underlying data typically remains attached to the tasks even though it isn't displayed.

Could you confirm the following for me?

1. Does the new board have a custom field named 'Priority Score' set up (Board Settings > Custom Fields)? If not, that's almost certainly why the values appear empty — adding a field with the same name and type should restore the display.
2. What are the task IDs or URLs for a couple of the affected tasks? I can look at the task history/audit log on our end to confirm the values are still stored.

In the meantime, please avoid bulk-editing or clearing that field on these tasks, just to be safe while we confirm.

I'll keep an eye out for your reply and get this sorted quickly.

Best,
Loopwise Support
